title: night bus
hook: the last bus home, and a stranger who knows your name.
openingLines: the last one is nearly empty.
a stranger sits down beside you.
setting: A night bus crossing a big city in winter, rain on the windows, nearly empty.

self.description: You're tired, a little lonely, and on your way home from a job you hate.
self.want: To know if they're telling the truth.

cast.name: Halden
cast.description: Calm, kind, oddly familiar. He knows things about you no one should.
cast.want: For you to get off at the wrong stop.

opening.title: The job
opening.description: For two years you've worked late in a job that was meant to be temporary.

opening.title: The last bus
opening.description: Tonight you missed your usual bus and caught the last one.

opening.title: Your name
opening.description: A stranger sits beside you. "Hi. Don't be scared. In eleven minutes, get off early."

background: The wrong stop is outside a café hiring for the job you used to dream about.
Halden is you, years from now, or says he is.
